title: Heartbox theme operations
purpose: Maintain the Heartbox palette, regenerate ports, deploy the product site, and ship SemVer releases.

steps.title: Edit canonical palette
steps.detail: Change colors only in palette/heartbox.json. Keep silver as cool metal for cursor/chrome.

steps.title: Regenerate ports
steps.detail: Run python3 scripts/generate-themes.py and review git diff under themes/ and palette/.

steps.title: Update product site swatches
steps.detail: If tokens change, update site/app.js COLORS array and site/styles.css :root variables to match.

steps.title: Deploy Pages
steps.detail: Push site/** to main (workflow pages.yml) or wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=f00-heartbox --branch=main.

steps.title: SemVer release
steps.detail: Bump version in palette JSON, CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README; tag; attach install.sh, file_id.diz, SOP PDF, memo PDF; update f00 hub card.
